intentComment: story 121: user-facing Balancer V3 phUSD/sUSDS BPT -> UniV2 phUSD/sUSDS migrator (proportional pre-pause, recovery post-BIP-928)

preview.behaviour: vm.startPrank(OWNER) around the CREATE; progress file NOT written; returns after _checkImmutables

broadcast.command: node scripts/backup-mainnet-addresses.js && export BALANCER_LP_MIGRATOR_GAS_PRICE_WEI=${BALANCER_LP_MIGRATOR_GAS_PRICE_WEI:-300000000} && forge script script/DeployBalancerLPMigratorMainnet.s.sol:DeployBalancerLPMigratorMainnet --rpc-url $RPC_MAINNET --sender 0xCad1a7864a108DBFF67F4b8af71fAB0C7A86D0B6 --broadcast --skip-simulation --slow --ledger --hd-paths "m/44'/60'/46'/0/0" --legacy --with-gas-price $BALANCER_LP_MIGRATOR_GAS_PRICE_WEI --gas-estimate-multiplier 200 -vvv && node scripts/patch-mainnet-addresses-balancer-lp-migrator.js && npm run balancer-lp-migrator:verify && node scripts/ledger-record.js DeployBalancerLPMigratorMainnet.s.sol 1
broadcast.behaviour: vm.startBroadcast() around ONE CREATE of BalancerLPMigrator from OWNER (Ledger); then _writeProgress()

verify.behaviour: view-only run(); preflight + immutables + previewMigrate(1e18) smoke test; fails before broadcast ('no BalancerLPMigrator address')

jsChain.joinSemantics: all steps joined with && — any non-zero exit (forge, patcher exit 1-4, verify revert) stops every later step, including ledger-record

chainIdSource: require(block.chainid == CHAIN_ID) with CHAIN_ID = 1 in both Deploy and Verify run()
